classification: Published machine-derived terrain classification; not hazard probability or direct soil measurement

source.title: NOAH-H terrain classifications of Jezero Crater, Mars
source.credit: Wright, Barrett, Fawdon, Favaro, Balme, Woods, Karachalios & Gerdes; The Open University / ESA NOAH

processing.fractionDefinition: Class sample counts divided by all 400 equal-area 0.25 m sample centres in each 5 m cell; unknown samples stay in the denominator. Fractions are sampling-based area estimates, not model probabilities.
processing.dominantClassDefinition: Largest known class area count; ties choose the lower published mosaic rank code. null if no classification samples.
processing.coordinateOperation: Mars sphere3396190 Eqc latTs0 to existing Mars sphere3396190 Eqc latTs18.4663; no Earth WGS84 substitution and no extra empirical image shift.

registration.status: Original source rasters were georeferenced by the authors; supplied tie points do not establish a measured residual against this project's later Caltech orthomosaic/DEM. No independent local registration residual measured.

limitations: Terrain class is a texture classification, not calibrated rockfall, bearing strength, sinkage, oxygen use, wheel slip, or astronaut safety.
Classification confidence and acquisition time are not encoded per pixel in this categorical mosaic.
Native0.25m sample spacing does not imply0.25m positional accuracy or validated small-obstacle clearance.
Unknown support must remain visible; no terrain class is assigned outside source coverage.

studyRegion.name: NOAH-H / Caltech overlap
studyRegion.selection: A third real 1 km crop in the narrow NOAH-H/Caltech DEM overlap; approximately 6 km east of the Perseverance landing, not the landing site itself.
